🟠 [tighten-mask-0o002-vs-0o007] MUST-FIX The tightening guard in `isOwnedMode700Dir` is `(st.mode & 0o002) === 0`, but the spec mandates `(mode & 0o007) === 0` (zero other bits) with group bits set. Confirmed real deviation: a pre-existing 0705, 0704, 0701, 0771 or 0755 candidate under a private parent now reaches chmod-and-accept instead of the spec-required reject-and-fall-through; the spec explicitly lists "any 'other' bits set" as a keep-reject case. Practical exposure is bounded because the parent must be 0700-owned (no foreign traversal), but the delivered contract is wider than the frozen spec, the inline comment ("other-write is off") documents the wrong boundary, and the new suites only pin 0777 so the widening is untested. Smallest remediation: change the guard to `(st.mode & 0o007) === 0` (optionally `&& (st.mode & 0o070) !== 0`, already implied by the enclosing `& 0o077` check), update the comment to say "no other bits at all", apply the same edit to the regenerated mirror under `platforms/codex/plugin/scripts/lib/live-state-dir.js`, and add one case (e.g. 0705 under a 0700 parent ⇒ rejected, mode unchanged) to `hooks/tests/live-dir-xdg-inference.test.sh` and/or `scripts/lib/live-state-dir.test.js`.
